title: Batch 2 concrete paraphrases for generic Chronicles persons_2 facts

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: ダビデは、主である神の御心であればイスラエル各地の人々を集め、契約の箱を運び戻そうと提案します。
changes.sourceText: David said to all the assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if it is of the LORD our God, let’s send word everywhere to our brothers who are left in all the land of Israel, with whom the priests and Levites are in their cities that have pasture lands, that they may gather themselves to us.
changes.previousContext: David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.
changes.nextContext: Also, let’s bring the ark of our God back to us again, for we didn’t seek it in the days of Saul.”

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: ダビデは、サウルの時代に神の箱を尋ね求めなかったとして、箱を再び自分たちのもとへ運ぶことを提案します。
changes.sourceText: Also, let’s bring the ark of our God back to us again, for we didn’t seek it in the days of Saul.”
changes.previousContext: David said to all the assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if it is of the LORD our God, let’s send word everywhere to our brothers who are left in all the land of Israel, with whom the priests and Levites are in their cities that have pasture lands, that they may gather themselves to us.
changes.nextContext: All the assembly said that they would do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: ダビデは、神の箱を運ぶため、エジプトのシホルからハマトの入口までのイスラエル全土から人々を集めます。
changes.sourceText: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor River of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring God’s ark from Kiriath Jearim.
changes.previousContext: All the assembly said that they would do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
changes.nextContext: David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there God the LORD’s ark that sits above the cherubim, that is called by the Name.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: ダビデとイスラエルの人々は、ケルビムの上に座す主なる神の箱をキルヤテ・エアリムから運び上ろうとします。
changes.sourceText: David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there God the LORD’s ark that sits above the cherubim, that is called by the Name.
changes.previousContext: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor River of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring God’s ark from Kiriath Jearim.
changes.nextContext: They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 神の箱は新しい車に載せられ、アビナダブの家から運び出されます。
changes.sourceText: They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.

changes.nextContext: David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with cymbals, and with trumpets.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: ダビデとイスラエルの人々は、歌や楽器を奏でて神の前で喜び祝います。
changes.sourceText: David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with cymbals, and with trumpets.
changes.previousContext: They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.
changes.nextContext: When they came to Chidon’s threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: ウザが箱に手を伸ばしたため、主の怒りが燃え上がり、神の前で彼は打たれて死にます。
changes.sourceText: The LORD’s anger burned against Uzza, and he struck him because he put his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.
changes.previousContext: When they came to Chidon’s threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.
changes.nextContext: David was displeased, because the LORD had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: ウザが打たれたことにダビデは憤り、その場所をペレツ・ウザと名付けます。
changes.sourceText: David was displeased, because the LORD had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.
changes.previousContext: The LORD’s anger burned against Uzza, and he struck him because he put his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.
changes.nextContext: David was afraid of God that day, saying, “How can I bring God’s ark home to me?”

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: その日、ダビデは神を恐れ、神の箱を自分のもとへどう運べるのかと問いかけます。
changes.sourceText: David was afraid of God that day, saying, “How can I bring God’s ark home to me?”
changes.previousContext: David was displeased, because the LORD had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.
changes.nextContext: So David didn’t move the ark with him into David’s city, but carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 神の箱はオベデ・エドムの家に三か月とどまり、主は彼の家と持ち物すべてを祝福します。
changes.sourceText: God’s ark remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months; and the LORD blessed Obed-Edom’s house and all that he had.
changes.previousContext: So David didn’t move the ark with him into David’s city, but carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.
changes.nextContext: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: ダビデは、主がイスラエルの王として自分を確立し、民のため王国を高めたと悟ります。
changes.sourceText: David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted, for his people Israel’s sake.
changes.previousContext: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.
changes.nextContext: David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David became the father of more sons and daughters.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: ペリシテ人に向かうべきかダビデが神に尋ねると、主は出陣を命じ、敵を彼の手に渡すと告げます。
changes.sourceText: David inquired of God, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” The LORD said to him, “Go up; for I will deliver them into your hand.”
changes.previousContext: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.
changes.nextContext: So they came up to Baal Perazim, and David defeated them there. David said, God has broken my enemies by my hand, like waters breaking out. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Perazim.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: ダビデはペリシテ軍を打ち破り、主が敵を押し流したと語って、その場所をバアル・ペラツィムと呼びます。
changes.sourceText: So they came up to Baal Perazim, and David defeated them there. David said, God has broken my enemies by my hand, like waters breaking out. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Perazim.
changes.previousContext: David inquired of God, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” The LORD said to him, “Go up; for I will deliver them into your hand.”
changes.nextContext: They left their gods there; and David gave a command, and they were burned with fire.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: ダビデが再び神に尋ねると、神は正面から上らず、桑の木の後ろへ回るよう命じます。
changes.sourceText: David inquired again of God; and God said to him, “You shall not go up after them. Turn away from them, and come on them opposite the mulberry trees.
changes.previousContext: The Philistines made another raid in the valley.
changes.nextContext: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then go out to battle; for God has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 桑の木の梢に行進の音が聞こえたら進めと神は告げ、自らペリシテ軍を打つため先行すると述べます。
changes.sourceText: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then go out to battle; for God has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”
changes.previousContext: David inquired again of God; and God said to him, “You shall not go up after them. Turn away from them, and come on them opposite the mulberry trees.
changes.nextContext: David did as God commanded him; and they attacked the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: ダビデは神の命令どおりに行動し、ペリシテ軍をギブオンからゲゼルまで攻めます。
changes.sourceText: David did as God commanded him; and they attacked the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.
changes.previousContext: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then go out to battle; for God has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”
changes.nextContext: The fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him on all nations.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: ダビデの名声が諸国に広がり、主が諸国に彼への恐れを起こしたと記されています。
changes.sourceText: The fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him on all nations.
changes.previousContext: David did as God commanded him; and they attacked the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.
changes.nextContext: David made himself houses in David’s city; and he prepared a place for God’s ark, and pitched a tent for it.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: ダビデは神の箱のため場所を備え、天幕を張ります。
changes.sourceText: David made himself houses in David’s city; and he prepared a place for God’s ark, and pitched a tent for it.
changes.previousContext: The fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him on all nations.
changes.nextContext: Then David said, “No one ought to carry God’s ark but the Levites. For the LORD has chosen them to carry God’s ark, and to minister to him forever.”

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: ダビデは、主がレビ人を選んで神の箱を運ばせ、永く仕えさせたため、箱を運ぶのはレビ人だけだと述べます。
changes.sourceText: Then David said, “No one ought to carry God’s ark but the Levites. For the LORD has chosen them to carry God’s ark, and to minister to him forever.”

changes.afterTextJa: ダビデは、準備した場所へ主の箱を運び上げるため、イスラエル全体をエルサレムに集めます。
changes.sourceText: David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up the LORD’s ark to its place, which he had prepared for it.
changes.previousContext: Then David said, “No one ought to carry God’s ark but the Levites. For the LORD has chosen them to carry God’s ark, and to minister to him forever.”
changes.nextContext: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: ダビデはレビ人の家長たちに身を清め、準備した場所へイスラエルの神である主の箱を運ぶよう求めます。
changes.sourceText: and said to them, “You are the heads of the fathers’ households of the Levites. Sanctify yourselves, both you and your brothers, that you may bring the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, up to the place that I have prepared for it.
changes.previousContext: David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites: for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab,
changes.nextContext: For because you didn’t carry it at first, the LORD our God broke out in anger against us, because we didn’t seek him according to the ordinance.”

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: ダビデは、最初に定められた手順で主を求めなかったため、主が怒りを現したと説明します。
changes.sourceText: For because you didn’t carry it at first, the LORD our God broke out in anger against us, because we didn’t seek him according to the ordinance.”
changes.previousContext: and said to them, “You are the heads of the fathers’ households of the Levites. Sanctify yourselves, both you and your brothers, that you may bring the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, up to the place that I have prepared for it.
changes.nextContext: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 祭司とレビ人は、イスラエルの神である主の箱を運び上げるため身を清めます。
changes.sourceText: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel.

changes.nextContext: The children of the Levites bore God’s ark on their shoulders with its poles, as Moses commanded according to the LORD’s word.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: レビ人は、モーセに命じられた主の言葉に従い、神の箱を担ぎ棒で肩に担ぎます。
changes.sourceText: The children of the Levites bore God’s ark on their shoulders with its poles, as Moses commanded according to the LORD’s word.
changes.previousContext: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel.
changes.nextContext: David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers with instruments of music, stringed instruments, harps, and cymbals, sounding aloud and lifting up their voices with joy.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 祭司たちは神の箱の前でラッパを吹き、オベデ・エドムとエヒヤは箱の門衛を務めます。
changes.sourceText: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before God’s ark; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
changes.previousContext: Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
changes.nextContext: So David, the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands went to bring the ark of the LORD’s covenant up out of the house of Obed-Edom with joy.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: ダビデとイスラエルの長老、千人隊長たちは、主の契約の箱を喜びをもって運び上ろうとします。
changes.sourceText: So David, the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands went to bring the ark of the LORD’s covenant up out of the house of Obed-Edom with joy.
changes.previousContext: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before God’s ark; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
changes.nextContext: When God helped the Levites who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 神が契約の箱を担ぐレビ人を助けたとき、彼らは雄牛七頭と雄羊七頭をいけにえとして献げます。
changes.sourceText: When God helped the Levites who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
changes.previousContext: So David, the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands went to bring the ark of the LORD’s covenant up out of the house of Obed-Edom with joy.
changes.nextContext: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who bore the ark, the singers, and Chenaniah the choir master with the singers; and David had an ephod of linen on him.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: イスラエル全体は、歓声と角笛、ラッパ、シンバル、弦楽器を鳴らしながら主の契約の箱を運び上げます。
changes.sourceText: Thus all Israel brought the ark of the LORD’s covenant up with shouting, with sound of the cornet, with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with stringed instruments and harps.
changes.previousContext: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who bore the ark, the singers, and Chenaniah the choir master with the singers; and David had an ephod of linen on him.
changes.nextContext: As the ark of the LORD’s covenant came to David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David dancing and playing; and she despised him in her heart.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 主の契約の箱がダビデの町に入ると、ミカルは窓から、踊るダビデを見ました。
changes.sourceText: As the ark of the LORD’s covenant came to David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David dancing and playing; and she despised him in her heart.
changes.previousContext: Thus all Israel brought the ark of the LORD’s covenant up with shouting, with sound of the cornet, with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with stringed instruments and harps.
changes.nextContext: They brought in God’s ark, and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 人々は神の箱をダビデが張った天幕の中央に据え、神の前で焼き尽くす献げ物と和解の献げ物をささげます。
changes.sourceText: They brought in God’s ark, and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
changes.previousContext: As the ark of the LORD’s covenant came to David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David dancing and playing; and she despised him in her heart.
